Gson adapter for Vec3iBridge from "x,y,z" strings; registered in Module for Vec3iBridge.class
minions.json data: categories (minion name -> category key) and xp (item id -> xp per item); used by SkyblockEnhancedMinionMenu to compute minion XP/levels

Skyblock inventory-buttons editor screen: edits HighlightButton size/scale/shape/colors/command/hover/item with live preview; language path .skyblockInventoryButtonsEditor

ShaderDefinition implementation id "motion_blur": PrevSampler sampler + Phosphor vec3 uniform
Quickplay options overlay: favorite toggle + keybind binding + done; method133 returns "Quickplay Overlay"
Element interface (getWidth/getHeight/render) implemented by every *WailaComponent, VerticalWailaGroup, WailaHandler and WailaIterator
Horizontal WAILA row: list of elements plus scale, lays them out left to right; toString "WAILARow(elements=..., scale=...)"

Method annotation carrying DynamicListenerIsEnabled.Type; applied to option getters (LightingExtension4, GuiRewindhandlers2Extension2) whose value is only meaningful while that dynamic listener is enabled

The WAILA (What Am I Looking At) HUD mod: block coords/correct tool/break time/light level/entities/cosmetics settings and render context
The Rewind recording/replay mod (getId "REWIND"): record/pause/marker keys, shadow rewind, mic+system audio, validates and opens RewindHandlers
The minimap HUD mod (shape/markers/waypoints/entity-marker settings, Ref...method94()), owns the MinimapMap and the render/marker providers

Upstream Blockbuster component: Tint color from "color"; registered under minecraft:particle_appearance_tinting, sorting index -10
mclib.math.functions.SSFunction: string-in/string-out function base ("cannot receive number arguments", stringValue(), booleanValue = equalsIgnoreCase("true"))
mclib.math.functions.trig.Cos: Math.cos(arg0); MathBuilder registers it as function "cos"
mclib.math.functions.classic.Abs: Math.abs(arg0); MathBuilder registers it as "abs"
mclib.math.functions.classic.Exp: Math.exp(arg0); MathBuilder registers it as "exp"
mclib.math.functions.limit.Min: Math.min(arg0,arg1); MathBuilder registers it as "min"
Upstream Blockbuster component: expiration_expression/max_lifetime -> particle.lifetime; registered under minecraft:particle_lifetime_expression, sorting index 1000
Upstream Blockbuster component: exactly the 4-float plane a,b,c,d and plane-crossing particle.dead test; registered under minecraft:particle_kill_plane, sorting index 100
Upstream Blockbuster shape base: offset/direction(inwards|vector)/surface_only; applied at particle spawn (IComponentParticleInitialize)
Upstream Blockbuster shape: random point in the target entity AABB (width/eye-height) with 6-way surface roll
Upstream Blockbuster shape: random unit vector scaled by "radius" (half radius when not surface_only)
Upstream Blockbuster shape: position = offset, fixed direction applied only for ShapeDirection.Vector
Upstream Blockbuster abstract rate base with the single MolangExpression particles field
Upstream Blockbuster component: spawn_rate/max_particles (default 50), per-emitter-tick emission with fraction carry
Upstream Blockbuster component: num_particles burst on the first emitter tick (default 10)
mclib.math.molang.functions.SinDegrees: Math.sin(deg/180*PI); MolangParser (Glintcolorizer3Iterator) registers it as "sin"
mclib.math.molang.functions.CosDegrees: Math.cos(deg/180*PI); MolangParser registers it as "cos" (distinct from the root Cos)
mclib.math.functions.utility.Lerp: Interpolations.lerp(a,b,t); registered as "lerp" in MathBuilder
mclib.math.functions.utility.HermiteBlend: 3x^2-2x^3; registered as "hermite_blend"
mclib.math.functions.utility.LerpRotate: Interpolations.lerpYaw(a,b,t); registered as "lerprotate"
mclib.math.functions.utility.Random: seeded/range random (3rd arg seeds, 2 args pick min..max); registered as "random"; suffixed to avoid the java.util.Random clash in the declaring file
Upstream Blockbuster component: position/rotation/scale/scale_billboard/direction/acceleration/gravity + linear/angular_velocity flags, sorting index 1000
Upstream Blockbuster meta component: creation_expression/per_update_expression on the emitter (IComponentEmitterInitialize+Update)

Nameplate-engine tinting: extends the root tinting component, renderOnScreen applies the Tint; registered for minecraft:particle_appearance_tinting

Upstream Blockbuster abstract motion base (empty body)
Upstream Blockbuster component: relative_position + rotation applied to the particle matrix
